rows.text: when bit `0x2` of `dl` is set, with `n` = qword `[rcx-8]`, calls `00809054(rcx, 8, n, 005DDAF0)` and, when bit `0x1` of `dl` is set, `00809950(rcx-8, n*8 + 8)`, and returns `rcx-8`; otherwise calls `006BA860(rcx)` and, when bit `0x1` of `dl` is set, `00809950(rcx, 8)`, and returns `rcx`
